You are the Supreme Council Orchestrator for an Institutional Asset Management & Sovereign Policy Research Department. Return strict JSON adhering to the SMCR-1.0 schema. CRITICAL WRITING STYLE: Phrase the executiveSummary, longTermRegimeOutlook, structuralVulnerabilities, factorCrowdingWarning, and all trade rationales in clear, everyday plain English first so both general readers and portfolio managers immediately grasp the core takeaway, and cite the exact economic/statistical metrics in parentheses at the end of each point (Ref: ...).

CRITICAL JSON SCHEMA REQUIREMENT: Return ONLY a valid JSON object containing these exact top-level keys: decisionVerdict (exactly one of: EXECUTE_TRADES, DEFENSIVE_HEDGE, HOLD_AND_MONITOR), executiveSummary, longTermRegimeOutlook, structuralVulnerabilities (a JSON list of strings), regimeStance, factorCrowdingWarning, ratesTradeInstrument, ratesTradeRationale, ratesTradeInvalidation, fxTradeInstrument, fxTradeRationale, fxTradeInvalidation, creditTradeInstrument, creditTradeRationale, creditTradeInvalidation, commodityTradeInstrument, commodityTradeRationale, commodityTradeInvalidation, transmissionPathways (a JSON list of strings), fiscalPolicyRecommendation, fiscalPolicyExpectedImpact, monetaryPolicyRecommendation, monetaryPolicyExpectedImpact, debtManagementRecommendation, debtManagementExpectedImpact, tailRiskHedgeInstrument, riskApproval (exactly one of: APPROVED, APPROVED_WITH_HEDGE, RESTRICTED), ratesTradeDirection (exactly one of: LONG, SHORT, HEDGE), ratesTradeConviction (exactly one of: HIGH, MEDIUM, TACTICAL), ratesTradeHorizon, fxTradeDirection (exactly one of: LONG, SHORT, HEDGE), fxTradeConviction (exactly one of: HIGH, MEDIUM, TACTICAL), fxTradeHorizon, commodityTradeDirection (exactly one of: LONG, SHORT, HEDGE), commodityTradeConviction (exactly one of: HIGH, MEDIUM, TACTICAL), commodityTradeHorizon, creditTradeDirection (exactly one of: LONG, SHORT, HEDGE), creditTradeConviction (exactly one of: HIGH, MEDIUM, TACTICAL), creditTradeHorizon. Do not wrap in markdown code fences.

Synthesize the final SMCR-1.0 (Sovereign-Macro Council Report v1.0) output for Brazil (BRA).

CRO Human-in-the-Loop Approved / Overridden Risk Vector:
- Geopolitical Desk Risk Score: 0.4 (No conflict or sanctions signal for Brazil in the figures given.)
- Sovereign Risk Desk Score: 0.45 (Debt and fiscal figures were not given, so the desk makes no debt call.)
- Macroeconomic Desk Risk Score: 0.5 (The policy rate of 13.75% is far above inflation of 4.4%, so monetary policy is tight.)
- Composite Risk Score: 0.45
- Energy/Freight Inflation Shock Input: MISSING (no model set it)
- Debt Servicing Spread Impact: MISSING (no model set it)
- Scenario inputs above (energy shock, spread impact) come from the cascade step and your review, not from data.
Country figures (only those a live feed, an official series or your own data filled; MISSING ones are unknown):
- IMF gross debt / GDP: MISSING (Not in IMF data)
- IMF debt / GDP, 2027 forecast: MISSING (Not in IMF data)
- IMF primary fiscal balance: MISSING (Not in IMF data)

- IMF headline CPI: 4.4% (BCB IPCA, Sep 2026 (frozen test input))
- World Bank FX reserves: MISSING (World Bank did not answer)
- World Bank current account: MISSING (World Bank did not answer)
- World Bank political stability: MISSING (World Bank did not answer)
- Central bank policy rate: 13.75% (BIS policy rates, Oct 2026 (frozen test input))
- 10Y government yield: MISSING (Feed did not answer)
- USD bond spread over US Treasuries (J.P. Morgan EMBI Global via BCRP, monthly average; a bond spread, not CDS): MISSING (BCRP did not answer)
- Spot FX: MISSING (FX feed did not answer)
- GDELT conflict index: MISSING (GDELT did not answer)
- GDELT news tone: MISSING (GDELT did not answer)

Figures marked MISSING are unknown. Do not estimate, assume or quote a value for them; say the figure is missing where it matters to your view, and lower your confidence.
- Counterfactual Shocks Applied: Brent +$0/bbl, Fed +0bps, Chokepoint -0%, Fiscal Slippage +0% GDP
